claim: select_rule_set(loaded, metadata) raises RuleSetRequestError for every identity refusal (no such rule set, account not bound, user ID invalid, rule set not confirmed), and str(exc) is the 'Request refused: ...' text
verify_hint: Check select_rule_set and RuleSetRequestError plus the REFUSED_* constants in rule_sets.py
evidence: rule_sets.py:1008-1038 select_rule_set raises RuleSetRequestError for no such rule set (1022, REFUSED_NO_SUCH_RULE_SET), account not bound (1028), user ID invalid (1031), rule set not confirmed (1035), plus key missing (1018). Constants at 858-862 all begin 'Request refused: '. RuleSetRequestError(RuntimeError) at 871-891 calls super().__init__(message) so str(exc) is the message. runner.py:223-226 catches it and uses detail=str(exc).

claim: query_database_impl_with_widgets accepts a metadata keyword (None or dict) and an agent keyword, and with metadata runs the rule-set selection, guard, row rules and writes one 'rule-set audit:' info line on the sqllens.tools.query_database logger per call
verify_hint: Check query_database_impl_with_widgets signature and its rule-set audit logging
evidence: query_database.py:552-562 signature has keyword-only metadata: Mapping|None and agent: Agent|None (plus metadata_discarded). Lines 651-695: when cfg.rule_sets.loaded is set, it strips metadata, calls select_rule_set (664), runs _query_database_turn with the selection (675), which publishes it via set_rule_set_selection (715) for the guard and row rules and checks conversation owner and catalog; a finally block (691-694) writes logger.info('%s', audit_line(outcome, **identity)) once per call, including on refusal or cancellation. logger = logging.getLogger('sqllens.tools.query_database') (line 64); audit_line returns 'rule-set audit: ' + json (rule_sets.py:933-945). runner.py:286-288 passes metadata= and agent= accordingly. Without a rule-set file no audit line is written (652-656), consistent with the claim's 'with metadata runs' under a rule set. Guard enforcement itself was not traced into safety/rule_sets.py beyond the selection being published.

claim: After the runner's own select_rule_set + confirm_catalog, the per-case wrapper's ensure_catalog_confirmed sees catalog.confirmed and opens no further catalog connection, so a passing run opens one catalog connection in total
verify_hint: Check confirm_catalog's state.confirmed early return and where query_database calls ensure_catalog_confirmed
evidence: runner.py:228-237: _verification_metadata calls confirm_catalog once (one run_blocking_sql connection, rule_sets.py:1213-1229) and on success sets loaded.catalog.confirmed = True. query_database.py:740 calls ensure_catalog_confirmed(cfg.database.url, rule_sets) per case, which delegates to confirm_catalog (rule_sets.py:1232-1239), whose first line after state = loaded.catalog is `if state.confirmed: return` (1221-1222), so no connection opens. rule_sets comes from cfg.rule_sets.loaded (query_database.py:710); verification_config (runner.py:87-108) uses cfg.model_copy with shallow updates that do not replace rule_sets, so the same LoadedRuleSets/catalog object is shared. Hence a passing run opens exactly one catalog connection (when a rule-set file is configured; with a custom driver no query_database call happens at all).

claim: confirm_catalog runs _check_catalog_blocking via run_blocking_sql and propagates RuleSetCatalogError (naming each mismatch) or any other exception unwrapped; ensure_catalog_confirmed keeps the prior behavior of logging a WARNING and raising RuleSetRequestError(REFUSED_CATALOG_UNCONFIRMED) for both
verify_against: src/sqllens/rule_sets.py base vs head; callers of ensure_catalog_confirmed
verify_hint: Compare ensure_catalog_confirmed in base and head rule_sets.py and grep its callers (tools/query_database.py, preflight)
evidence: Head rule_sets.py:1213-1229 confirm_catalog: checks confirmed, takes state.lock, rechecks, awaits run_blocking_sql(_check_catalog_blocking, url, loaded) with no try/except, so RuleSetCatalogError (documented as naming each mismatch) and any other exception propagate unwrapped; sets confirmed only on success. Head 1232-1249 ensure_catalog_confirmed wraps confirm_catalog: RuleSetCatalogError -> logger.warning + raise RuleSetRequestError(REFUSED_CATALOG_UNCONFIRMED); other Exception -> logger.warning (exc_info) + same raise. Base 1217-1244 had identical except branches/messages inline around run_blocking_sql, with confirmed set after success, so the behavior is unchanged. run_blocking_sql (sql_threads.py:140) does not wrap func exceptions in the portion read (only raises SqlWorkersBusyError on slot timeout). Callers were not separately grepped; the signature is unchanged.

claim: The CLI catches VerificationIdentityError and renders it with option labels (--rule-set, --account, --user), exiting 1, and the eval package exports VerificationIdentityError
verify_hint: Check verify-memory in cli.py for describe(labels) usage and eval/__init__.py exports
evidence: src/sqllens/cli.py:609 imports VerificationIdentityError from sqllens.eval; cli.py:650-657 wraps asyncio.run(run_verification(...)) in try/except VerificationIdentityError, calls e.describe({'rule_set': '--rule-set', 'account_id': '--account', 'user_id': '--user'}), prints the message, and raises typer.Exit(code=1). The except is ordered before the generic Exception handler (cli.py:658). eval/runner.py:151-176 describe(labels) uses the supplied labels for every kind. src/sqllens/eval/__init__.py:19 imports and :28 lists VerificationIdentityError in __all__. The only path to the handler is run_verification raising the error, which runner.py:192-232 does.

claim: The docstring says the identity error is raised before any case and any agent work for each listed condition, and that a driver passed in receives no identity
source_excerpt:
Before any case and any
    agent work, ``VerificationIdentityError`` is raised when:
verify_hint: Trace an identity that passes selection but whose catalog check fails, confirming build_agent at line 281 is not reached; and confirm a supplied driver is called without metadata
evidence: runner.py:275 awaits _verification_metadata before verification_config (276) and build_agent (281) and before the case loop (299). Each listed condition raises VerificationIdentityError inside it: any identity value `is not None` with no loaded file (191-192, so an empty string counts); rule_set/user_id missing or empty via `not value` (194-198); empty account_id with len(binding.account_ids) != 1 (199-205, exactly one is defaulted at 206); select_rule_set refusal (223-226); confirm_catalog failure, or any other exception, mapped to the catalog error (227-236). Only after those does it set catalog.confirmed = True (237). Counter-input traced: an identity that passes selection but fails the catalog check raises at 230 or 236, so build_agent at 281 is never reached. A supplied driver is used directly as impl (291-292) and called as driver(forced_cfg, case.question) at 311-313 with no metadata; only the production _prod_driver (286-288) passes metadata=metadata. The docstring matches the code.
